header_position.info: Applies from 990px up. Pinned holds the heading still beside the deck while the cards stack past it.

header_pin_mobile.label: Also pin the heading on mobile
header_pin_mobile.info: Off by default. A pinned bar takes about a fifth of a phone screen for the whole section, and the card numbers already show where you are. Worth turning on for a short two or three word heading.

header_reserve_mobile.label: Space for the pinned heading on mobile
header_reserve_mobile.info: Only used when the heading is pinned on mobile. How far down the cards start, to clear it — raise it for a two-line heading or one with text under it.

card_layout.label: Card layout
card_layout.info: Cards without an image are always a single column.

card_height.label: Minimum card height
card_height.info: Desktop and tablet. Mobile uses a share of the screen instead.

card_height_mobile.label: Card height on mobile
card_height_mobile.info: Share of the screen each card fills, so one card reads as roughly one screen on any phone.

stack_path.label: Direction the deck fans
stack_path.info: Sideways and diagonal narrow the cards to keep the fan inside the page, and both fall back to Down below 750px where there is no width to spare.

stack_step.label: Offset between cards
stack_step.info: How much of each card stays visible once the next one covers it. Set to 0 to stack them exactly on top of each other.

stack_offset.label: Distance from the top
stack_offset.info: Measured below the sticky header, if you have one.

card_gap.label: Scroll between cards
card_gap.info: How far you scroll before the next card arrives. This section uses roughly one card height of scroll per card, so keep the number of cards low.

stack_end.label: Hold at the end
stack_end.info: How long the finished deck stays on screen before the section scrolls away. The last card needs some of this to settle at all.

show_payment_terms.label: Show Shop Pay Installments
show_payment_terms.info: Shows the customer that they can pay in installments. Appears only when the store and the price qualify.

paragraph__1.content: Kofii Flow uses color schemes. Every section picks a scheme instead of defining its own colors, so a change here updates the whole storefront.

paragraph__4.content: Eyebrows, badges and small labels share one style so the storefront stays consistent.

space_scale.label: Spacing scale
space_scale.info: Scales every spacing token at once, including section padding.

radius_scale.label: Corner rounding
radius_scale.info: 0% gives fully square corners across the theme.

product_card_equal_height.label: Match card heights in a row
product_card_equal_height.info: Cards fill the tallest in their row and prices line up along the bottom, so a longer product title cannot make the grid look ragged.

product_card_quick_add.info: Adds single-variant products straight to the cart. Products with options open a panel so the shopper can choose.

product_card_swatches.label: Show color swatches
product_card_swatches.info: Uses the swatches configured on your product options.

product_card_rating.label: Show rating

motion_section_transitions.label: Enable section transitions
motion_section_transitions.info: Lets a section round and overlap into the section below it.

cart_show_note.label: Let shoppers add an order note

cart_free_shipping.info: Only turn this on if you actually offer free shipping at a threshold. Set the real rate up in Settings > Shipping.

cart_free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold
cart_free_shipping_threshold.info: The amount in your store currency, without a symbol. For example: 75

favicon.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32px.

share_image.label: Social sharing image
share_image.info: Used when a page has no image of its own. 1200 x 630px recommended.

brand_twitter_handle.label: X (Twitter) handle
brand_twitter_handle.info: Without the @ symbol. Used for social sharing cards.
